qt: to the Commission Cynthia Ní Mhurchú (Renew) Subject:

High energy costs can place significant pressure on households, small businesses, farms and energy-intensive employers. These pressures can be particularly difficult for rural communities and businesses with limited access to public transport or alternative energy sources. 1.
What additional measures can the Commission take to help Member States reduce energy poverty and protect vulnerable households from sustained high energy costs?
How will the Commission support investment in electricity grid infrastructure, interconnection, storage and renewable generation to improve energy security and affordability in Ireland?

Will the Commission assess whether existing EU funding and State aid frameworks provide sufficient flexibility to support viable small businesses facing exceptional energy costs while maintaining the objectives of the clean energy transition?
